title: Agent Harness Profile 0.2 approval request
description: A request for a human decision on one tool call with exactly these arguments. Created in state pending. Changed arguments require a new request. Requirement levels in property descriptions follow the profile: Required, Conditionally Required, Recommended, Opt-In.

$schema.description: Opt-In. URI of this JSON Schema. When present it MUST be exactly this schema's $id.

id.description: Required. Unique, unguessable identifier of the request.

created_at.description: Required. RFC 3339 date-time at which the request was created.

expires_at.description: Required. RFC 3339 date-time at which the request expires (created_at plus timeout_seconds). A decision at or after this instant is invalid and the request becomes expired, which is treated as deny.

requester.description: Required. The agent run that asks for approval. The requesting agent can never decide the request.

agent_id.description: Required. Principal id of the requesting agent (the Agent Spec component id in agent.json, or the deployment's agent principal id).

run_id.description: Required. Identifier of the agent run.

task_id.description: Required. Identifier of the task the run works on. The idempotency key is bound to it.

dispatcher.description: Conditionally Required: present whenever a human assigned the task. Principal id of the human who dispatched (assigned) the task; decisions by this principal are marked decided_by_dispatcher and are valid only if separation_of_duties.dispatcher_may_approve is true.

tool.description: Required. The tool to be called.

name.description: Required. Tool name as in agent.json and harness.json (ASCII letters, digits, _ and -, 1 to 64 characters).

kind.description: Required. Effective kind of the tool after classification.

arguments_digest.description: Required. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form of the tool arguments. This is the enforced_identity a decision MUST echo.

idempotency_key.description: Required. Idempotency key of the write this request gates (draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header-08). Execution happens at most once per key.

summary.description: Required. Three plain sentences shown to the approver. Derived from trusted records; untrusted free text MUST NOT be copied in verbatim.

done.description: Required. What has been done so far.

decide.description: Required. What needs the approver's decision.

path.description: Required. How approvers were chosen: named (a specific person named by the template or deployment), list (any one of a list) or fallback (the fallback approvers because the named or listed ones were unavailable).

approvers.description: Required. Human principal ids that may decide. A decision by anyone else is invalid. Agent principals MUST NOT appear.

policy_ref.description: Required. Reference to the policy that produced the escalation, for example template id plus Cedar policy id (reception-enquiry#policy1) or a URI.
